papers.title: A global analysis of ${\bar B}\to DP$ and ${\bar B} \to {\bar D} P$ decays
papers.abstract: Recently, a fit to the 15 measured branching ratios of ${\bar B} \to D P$ decays ($B = \{B^+, B^0, B_s^0\}$, $D = \{D^0, D^+, D_s^+\}$, $P \in \{π, K\}$) was performed under the assumption of flavor SU(3) symmetry [SU(3)$_F$]. A terrible fit was found: there was a $> 5σ$ disagreement with the SU(3)$_F$ limit of the Standard Model [SM$_{\rm{SU(3)}_F}$]. papers.title: Nodal nematic superconductivity in moiré graphene
papers.abstract: Unconventional superconductivity can emerge in various forms in strongly correlated systems. Historically, the most extensively studied examples include nodal and triplet pairing, which were experimentally detected in cuprates and superfluid helium-3, respectively. Beyond these canonical cases, there are also nematic superconductors, in which the rotational symmetry of the lattice is broken in the superconducting state. papers.title: Heavy-Heavy-Light-Light correlators from holography on the worldsheet
papers.abstract: We study correlation functions of light local operators and defect changing operators on the conformal line set by the 1/2 BPS Wilson line of $\mathcal N=4$ super Yang-Mills. We consider the defect changing operators associated with geometrical and internal cusp angles, which at strong coupling have a large scaling dimension and back-react on the dual $AdS_2$ world-sheet. papers.title: VITAL: From Visual Motion to Precise Action
papers.abstract: World-action models aim to turn visual anticipation into driving decisions, yet typically train action experts on trajectory representations defined independently of visual dynamics. This motivates deriving action targets directly from visual motion. We first examine a simpler setting in which trajectories are reconstructed from recorded future images.
